name: ClassVRoom
summary:
Step into the captivating world of "ClassVRoom," the ultimate VR Teaching Simulator designed to empower and train aspiring educators. This innovative and immersive experience transports you into a lifelike classroom environment, where you can take on the role of a teacher and embark on a journey of pedagogical exploration.
Interact with an extensive array of teaching tools, from the traditional blackboard to modern web browsing and multimedia presentations.
